Odisha Govt Probes Ex-CM Patnaik's Foreign Trips; He Calls Allegations False

The Odisha government has launched a probe into former Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik's foreign trips. Patnaik has responded to the investigation, calling the allegations "false." He stated that an "appropriate response will be given" regarding the probe.
